name: Bite Wing
tagline: Run the front desk like you actually enjoy it. (Nobody's judging if you don't.)
positioning: The operations layer for owner-operated dental practices — scheduling, claims, and recalls that stop leaking money while you're elbow-deep in a molar.

hero.h1: The front desk software your practice deserves but keeps ignoring
hero.sub: Bite Wing runs scheduling, insurance claims, and patient recalls for solo and small-group dental practices — so the empty chairs and denied claims stop quietly eating your revenue.

features.title: Recalls that actually recall
features.description: Patients ghost the six-month cleaning until Bite Wing texts, emails, and re-texts them on autopilot. You fill the schedule without your front desk playing phone tag.

features.title: Claims that don't bounce
features.description: Scrub every insurance claim before submission, catch the missing tooth number, and flag the codes payers love to reject. Fewer denials, faster reimbursements.

features.title: Schedule you can read at a glance
features.description: See gaps, double-books, and no-show risk on one color-coded day view built for a busy operatory, not a spreadsheet from 2009.

features.title: No-show radar
features.description: Bite Wing scores every appointment on cancellation risk from history and lead time, then overbooks the risky slots just enough to keep the chair warm.

features.title: Production dashboard
features.description: Track daily production, collections, and unscheduled treatment per provider without exporting anything or bothering your accountant.

features.title: Works with your PMS
features.description: Syncs with Open Dental, Dentrix, and Eaglesoft so you keep your charts and lose the busywork. No rip-and-replace nightmare.

testimonials.quote: We were writing off denied claims like it was a personality trait. Bite Wing caught the coding errors before submission and our collections jumped 14% in a quarter. My office manager cried, in a good way.
testimonials.name: Dr. Priya Ramanathan

testimonials.quote: The recall texts alone paid for the whole thing. We used to have twelve empty hygiene slots a week. Now I'm the one apologizing to the schedule.
testimonials.name: Marcus Whitfield

testimonials.quote: I bought it expecting another dashboard I'd never open. I open it every morning with my coffee. That's the highest praise I have for software.
testimonials.name: Dr. Elena Kovac

pricing.blurb: For the one-dentist practice that wears every hat.
For growing offices with a front desk that never sits down.
For multi-location groups and DSOs that hate surprises.

homepage.footerBlurb: Bite Wing keeps small dental practices scheduled, reimbursed, and slightly less stressed. Built by people who've sat in the waiting room too long.
